messages:
Priya Das: opening a small PR to update Velvet13B model card: add long-context bench results, clarify supported quant variants, and include SDK v2 examples for streaming + embeddings. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4921 :wave:
Priya Das: added a short 'Known behavior' note about KV cache warm-up (first few tokens slower) and example config for Dedicated pool sizing. pinging @Josh for the limits wording and @Selena for quant phrasing
Maria Chen: quick read 1: the limits table looks fine but we should clarify 'context ceiling' vs 'recommended context' - users keep hitting the ceiling without checking kv-cache warnings
Josh Patel: agree. suggest columns: recommended_context, max_supported_context, measured_tail_latency. helps set expectations. also can we add a short sentence about truncated prompts and how the runtime signals truncation in the response metadata?
Liam O'Neill: spotted one outdated JS snippet: it uses `client.createStream()` (v1). new SDK v2 should use `client.responses.stream()`. simple fix, I'll push one commit with corrected JS and Python streaming examples:
```
// JS (SDK v2)
const resp = await client.responses.create({model: 'velvet-13b', input: prompt});
for await (const event of client.responses.stream(resp)) {
  if (event.type === 'response.delta') console.log(event.delta);
}
```

```
# Python (SDK v2)
resp = client.responses.create(model='velvet-13b', input=prompt)
for event in client.responses.stream(resp):
  if event.type == 'response.delta':
    print(event.delta)
```
Priya Das: thanks Liam, please also add a short example of checking metadata for `truncated=true` when a request exceeds max_input_tokens
Selena Rivera: compatibility note: Velvet13B-4bit uses block-quant (block=16). on Dedicated you must enable `--quant-block=16` or it will be considered incompatible. add fallback note: runtime falls back to `velvet-13b-fp16` unless `strict_compat=true` in model config
bench-bot: benchmark report link check: https://bench.redwood-infra.com/velvet13b/2026-03.csv returned 200 OK (summary: p50=36ms/token, p95=95ms/token @1024 seq on p4d)
Maria Chen: one broken link reported by docs-bot earlier: internal guide link to model-card/velvet13b/benchmarks had a trailing slash causing 404. I'll patch it and add an S3 canonical link for the raw CSV (s3://bench-results/velvet13b/2026-03/summary.csv)
docs-bot: lint results for PR #4921: 4 style nits, 1 missing code fence language tag, 0 critical errors
Josh Patel: added wording for the limits table and a tiny note about embed-dim migration: new velvet embeddings are 1024d (old v1 was 768). included a short migration snippet to reshape arrays and a note about downstream indexers needing reindexing
Priya Das: added the embed migration snippet and a quick migration checklist (reindex, update dims in schema, run sample queries). also fixed the docs-bot style nits and added the code fence language tag
Liam O'Neill: validated the streaming examples locally, and tested the embed example against the new API. all smoke tests passed
docs-bot: PR #4921 updated: linkcheck passed, examples smoke tests passed, lint checks passed
Priya Das: planning to merge in 2 hours unless objections. will include a changelog entry for catalog release 2026-03
Josh Patel: :+1: go ahead if no further comments
Selena Rivera: LGTM. thanks for catching the quant flag details
Maria Chen: merging now. tagging release-notes/velvet13b-longcontext
